dedupe_keys.name: comunidad autonoma de canarias flood hazard datasets

description: Comunidad Autónoma de Canarias: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comunidad Autónoma de Canarias. Coverage: Comunidad Autónoma de Canarias. The listing groups 7 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Información hidrometeorológica para análisis de avenidas - La Palma; Información hidrometeorológica para análisis de avenidas - La Gomera; Información hidrometeorológica para análisis de avenidas - Fuerteventu; Información hidrometeorológica para análisis de avenidas - Tenerife. Formats seen: ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://datos.canarias.es/portal/aviso-legal-y-condiciones-de-uso). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
